about.title: About Lunatech
about.p1: Lunatech is a creative team focused on building and evolving digital products.
about.p2: We work at the intersection of design and technology to deliver functional, aesthetic, and lasting solutions for brands.
about.p3: Our goal isn’t just to exist online — it’s to make a difference.

approach.title: Our approach
approach.p1: We look at every project through a strategic lens.
approach.p2: We balance aesthetics and performance to ship products that create real user value.
approach.p3: For us, design isn’t only how it looks — it’s how it works.

process.title: Process
process.discoverDetail: Align on goals, constraints, and audiences before we shape the work.
process.designDetail: Structure, visuals, and interaction — crafted for clarity and conversion.
process.buildDetail: Engineering with polish: performance, accessibility, QA, and resilient delivery.
process.launchDetail: Ship, measure, and iterate with a clear handover and support plan.
process.subtitle: Each phase is planned and transparent.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Lunatech ("we", "us") we respect the privacy of our visitors. This page explains what information we collect through our site (lunatech.az), how it's used, and what rights you have over it.
privacy.collectionBody: We only collect what you submit yourself through the contact form: full name, email address, phone number, chosen service, and your message. In addition, anonymous usage analytics (page views, device type) are collected via Google Ads.
privacy.useBody: Submitted information is used solely to respond to your inquiry, prepare a proposal, and stay in touch with you. Analytics data is used to measure the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns.
privacy.sharingBody: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Data may be shared only with the tools we use to run the site and measure advertising (e.g. Google Ads), which are subject to their own privacy policies.
privacy.cookiesBody: Our site uses cookies for core functionality and for Google Ads advertising measurement. You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.retentionBody: Information submitted through the contact form is kept for as long as needed to resolve your inquiry, and may be deleted afterward.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data. You can reach us through the contact channel listed below to exercise this right.
privacy.contactBody: If you have a question or request regarding this policy, please reach out via the contact form on our site.
